chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So in a nutshell, a neural network is a structure that learns to predict information based on

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: what it has learned, through either a training stage or continuous evaluation.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: This is a three-layer sequential neural network.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It has three inputs and produces one output.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The middle layer is the hidden layer.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It's what processes the information.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Almost every neural network is different.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: This can mean a different number of input nodes, output nodes, hidden layers, or hidden

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: nodes per layer.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: You can even skip the hidden layer completely, but that wouldn't be very effective for most

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: situations.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: A neural network is useless without the synapses.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Synapses are the connections between layers and they are what makes or breaks a neural

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: network.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: From the moment of creation, the nodes of a neural network stay the same.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It's the synapses that change.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Each synapse has a value or weight.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: These are multipliers that affect how much of a layer is transferred into another.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So this is a two-layer neural network and it will be easier to explain with.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It has two inputs, two synapses, and one output.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Let's say we're trying to predict whether the output is a 0 or 1 based on the two inputs

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: which are both either 0s or 1s.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: In this situation, the relation is that the output is always equal to the first input.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: To train this, we will need a dataset of previously known inputs and outputs and this is what

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: the network will learn from.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So that's the table right there and that is the previous information.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: To start with, the synapses will be equal to some random number between minus 1 and

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The synapses basically multiply the input connection by themselves and the result gets

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: added to the output connection's total.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: In a normal neural network, there are also things called activation functions.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: They are a curve or linear line that processes the resulting total of a node.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Normally you will use something called a rectifier which basically makes it so that if the resulting

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: value is less than 0, it becomes 0.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Everything else remains unaffected.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It's represented by the rectifier symbol.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The way you improve the synapses is by using something called backpropagation.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: I'm not going to go too much into the maths behind it because it's quite complicated

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: but here's the main idea.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: You evaluate the error, then you update the weights by how much they are responsible for

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: this error.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Applying that to this example, we know the output should be 1 but it outputs 0.5.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: This is because the weights are wrong.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So we evaluate the error by comparing the result to the correct answer.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So 1 minus 0.5 equals 0.5 which means the error is 0.5.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: We adjust everything according to that and in this example, the output ended up being

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: correct but the weights would not work with everything else because they are not perfect.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: What you do to solve this is repeat the process with some different examples.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: In this situation, you can see that it is not perfect but it was close.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: So you repeat the backpropagation process and now, not only does it work, the weights

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: are trained for every situation.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: While this situation only needed a few repetitions, more complicated networks might need hundreds

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: or thousands of repetitions.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: For more complex neural networks, nothing changes.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Use the same process but on a larger scale.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The inputs feed into the hidden layer, the hidden layer feeds into the output layer and

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: this type of neural network could be used to, for example, predict house prices.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It would need some relevant information such as age and size and could go from there.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: You can also have multiple outputs for things like categorization.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: From this process, neural networks can learn to predict anything that is physically predictable.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: There are other parts and variations, for example, biases.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Biases are just nodes that are equal to 1 with weights that are tuned with all the others.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: They exist because sometimes a constant input that doesn't change is necessary to function

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: or be consistent.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It also just speeds up the network.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: Earlier when I mentioned the activation function rectifier, I didn't mention that there are

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: other types of activation functions.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The most common one is called the logistic or sigmoid function.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It's good for probabilities because it makes it so that the outputs are more definitive

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: which is good for when you need to make a choice based on it.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: It is represented by the second symbol.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: The other symbol is the hyperbolic tangent and it is the same as sigmoid but extends

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: into the negatives.

chunks.title: Neural Networks
chunks.text: This is the basic concept behind neural networks.
